reader.zh-Hant: 主代理（Orchestrator）用的 TODO 與影片模板 meta 讀取工具；不載入 base.html 全文。
reader.en: Orchestrator tools for TODO JSON state and video template metadata (not full HTML).
reader.ja: TODO 状態とテンプレート meta 読み取り（base.html 全文なし）のオーケストレーター向けツール。

tool_contract.name: manage_todo_list
tool_contract.description: Load or update orchestration TODO list for the current conversation.

tool_contract.name: list_video_templates
tool_contract.description: List video HTML templates with meta.json summaries.

symbols.name: ReadVideoTemplateTool
symbols.summary: Read meta.json and optional system_prompt excerpt for one template id.

tool_contract.name: read_video_template
tool_contract.description: Read template meta and optional system_prompt.md (bounded); not base.html body.

runtime_notes.content: Requires _conversation_id injected by AgentRuntime.execute; use manage_todo_list only on host agent.
After mutations, tools may emit phase=todo_updated via _runtime_event_handler; runtime forwards todo_updated events.
